page_title: Cove — A harbor for your agents.

sources.entry: Cove - Open-source native composer, session sidebar and diff viewer for Claude Code and Codex, currently available as an Apple Silicon preview. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/huyanxius/Cove) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Cove
summary.one_liner: Cove is an open-source, Mac-native workspace for running Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions with a session sidebar, a native input composer, and a diff viewer.
use_cases: resume and manage past Claude Code or Codex sessions
run several coding agent sessions side by side
review files and diffs an agent changed
track token usage and 5-hour or 7-day limits
work with git worktrees and PR checks alongside an agent
summary.what_it_does: Cove launches the user's installed claude and codex CLIs inside a real terminal, so the original interface, shortcuts, slash commands, MCP, hooks and skills behave as the CLI itself provides. It adds a left sidebar that lists sessions grouped by project, with search, pinning and renaming, and a status dot per session (blue while working, orange when waiting for input). It includes an optional native Mac input box below the terminal for selection, undo, multi-line text, attachments and pasted screenshots. A right-side panel lists files and diffs the agent changed, lets the user comment on a line and send that back to the session, and shows Git branch, working tree and PR check info.
notable: Runs the user's own claude and codex CLIs in a real terminal, with no separate API key or subscription needed
Right-side diff viewer where line comments are sent back to the agent session
Shows 5-hour, 7-day and context usage as rings, plus session time and token counts
Per-session Git worktree launch (Shift-Command-N) for parallel Claude sessions
caveats: Apple Silicon preview; Intel Mac build from source is not yet verified
Codex usage is only visible inside the conversation view for now
Antigravity (agy) integration is experimental and lacks approval, interrupt and pre-resume message history
Cost estimates are API-price based and do not reflect actual subscription spending; PR features need an logged-in gh CLI
Requires Xcode or Command Line Tools with Swift 6 to build from source
